string.text: Our Tuatha'an caravan have wandered much of the Westlands, I have visited villages around Tear, seen the Stone, once we even got close enough to Tar Valon to see the white tower.
A stormy night a few weeks ago I got lost in the darkness and couldn't find my way back, thankfully some villagers took care of me for a while.
Now I am staying here waiting for someone who might put me on the right path.
I do not know the song. If you can help me you might find the song on the road
I don't know anything about some silly song. What are you talking about?
If you are offering the chance for me to find the tune , i will offer you all that i have learned in return. As long I don't have to hurt anyone
I am determinded to find the song, if going with you is what it take then that it how the pattern weaves.
